estimand: OLS slope of post-fit range residual on cos(elongation) with intercept; eta = A/13 m
method: Delaunay-family forward model: per-line synodic projection under the real epoch sampling, joint (cosD, cos psi_j, sin psi_j) amplitude fits, required-vs-measured amplitude test, and simultaneous partialling of the principal tide/libration lines
interpretation: Every tide/libration-family line with non-trivial synodic reach is either spectrally degenerate with the measured channel (within 4 Rayleigh units of D) or measured below the amplitude required to source it. The family's real content (evection, monthly, fortnightly lines) is additive and does not absorb the cos(D) term: simultaneous partialling leaves the synodic coefficient negative and significant in both ephemerides.
